svg.title: MigrationLens — Sql Migration Risk
svg.desc: Finds application code that still depends on MySQL-only behaviour before a PostgreSQL cutover; deterministic rules first, every fix validated. Evidence: 37/37 expected findings on the documented Sakila fixture, not general accuracy.
